title: Posting Policy Premium to the Installment Payment Plans
content:
Every premium written and additional premium transaction of the billed term is posted to its plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** as a charge, and every return premium transaction as a credit, for the same amount on the day the policy transaction is processed, referencing it. Each policy premium transaction is posted to the plan only once; an existing posting that references the same policy transaction is the evidence. Fully earned fees are charged with the policy transaction that produced them. Premium is never posted to a plan whose term it does not belong to.

| Policy transaction (hypothetical) | Posting on the plan |
|---|---|
| additional premium of 64.00 on an owner term, processed on a given day | charge of 64.00 that same day, referencing that transaction |
| return premium of 31.50 | credit of 31.50 that same day |
| the same additional premium presented a second time | not posted again |
| premium of a different term | never posted to this plan |
